name: cartly-e2e-video
description: Records a narrated end-to-end test of the Cartly API against the Firestore Emulator

scripts.record: npm --prefix ../backend run build && cd ../backend && npx -y firebase-tools@13 emulators:exec --only firestore --project cartly-dev "node ../e2e-video/record.js"
scripts.record:mobile: npm --prefix ../backend run build && node build-mobile-web.js && cd ../backend && npx -y firebase-tools@13 emulators:exec --only firestore --project cartly-dev "node ../e2e-video/record-mobile.js"
